matter_background.original: Gunadasa Wedaarachchi was allotted by the final decree of Partition case bearing No. 2087/P dated 09.11.1995 in the District Court of Colombo, the allotment of land marked Lot 2 together with the right of way marked Lot R containing in extent 20 perches depicted in partition plan No.1100 dated 02.02.1992 made by R. Alwis Licensed Surveyor. He built a house on this land bearing Assessment No: 209/B, Melder Place, Rajagiriya. Gunadasa Wedaarachchi upon Deed No.2182 dated 07.06.2001 attested by S. Saluhewa Notary Public of Colombo gifted the said Lot 2 together with the right of way over marked Lot R depicted in partition plan No. 1100 aforesaid unto his youngest son Keerthi Wedaarachchi subject to the life interest of the donor as a gift absolute and irrevocable. Gunadasa Wedaarachchi died on 19.03.2017. Keerthi Wedaarachchi was married to Janani Nanayakkara and had one brother namely Dusantha and two sisters namely Priyanka and Nilmini. Priyanka died intestate on 12.06.2018 leaving her widower Sisira and one child namely Yasitha. Nilmini died on 13.05.2019 intestate unmarried and issueless. Gunadasa also had a son Kamal from his first wife who is deceased. Keerthi died on 12.05.2020 intestate and issueless, Malani Wedaarachchi, the mother of Keerthi instituted testamentary proceedings to administer the estate of her late son in the District Court of Colombo Case bearing No.198/T/2020. The Letters of Administration were issued to her and the proceedings were terminated on 14.10.2020.
